@graph.comment: Verifies the ID-JAGs presented as Bearer tokens on `.sai` routes. The audience is accepted when it is any URL under this auth service's base URL: one-time interactions use the full request URL, `/.sai/agents/*` uses the target UAS base URL. The issuer is this UAS (`trustedIssuers`), so the CID subject-document lookup is skipped; a federated issuer is resolved through the subject CID document. No Solid-OIDC/WebID fallback and no first-hop CID suite.

Credentials for `.sai` routes: an ID-JAG as a plain Bearer token (DPoP is only used at the first ID-JAG exchange), or no credentials. The Public fallback keeps anonymous `/.sai/agents` discovery working.
